name: adversarial-review-s1-lens-runner
title: Adversarial-review S1: lens runner (lens to lane mapping + independent per-lens run plan + injected-seam runner)
description: Story S1 (PARALLEL, MVP) of the adversarial-review build program (docs/adversarial-review-spec.md §5, §4.2). Implement the LENS RUNNER: drive the canonical lens set (from S0) as independent reviewers over a change, each mapped per the §4.2 table to one of the six real review_run_start lanes (lattice-review-concept/-quality/-behavior/-test-coverage/-docs; crash-safety/edge -> behavior), each returning PASS or raw Finding[]. New module packages/main/src/core/adversarial-review-lens-runner.ts importing S0's contract (core/adversarial-review.ts): a LENS_TO_LANE mapping (§4.2), a LensRunRequest/LensRunResult type, buildLensRunPlan(change, lensSet) producing one INDEPENDENT request per lens (each carries only the change + its lane — NEVER another lens's output), a runLenses(change, lensSet, runLens) orchestrator that applies an INJECTED per-lens function (the seam for the actual review agent; the main agent / harness supplies it at MVP) and collects per-lane raw Finding[], and a collectRawFindings aggregator. Independence is load-bearing (a lens never sees another lens's findings). NO verification (S2), NO finding_add / ledger mapping (S2), NO critic (S3), NO escalation (S4). A hermetic smoke with a FAKE runLens proves: every mapped lane is in the six real lanes (cross-checked against review-run.ts REVIEW_RUN_LANES), the plan has one independent request per lens covering the (possibly subset) lens set, runLenses applies the fake + aggregates per-lane Finding[] (S0 schema), and a PASS lens yields no findings. Registered in lattice.config.json.
